weak_joints: Pipeline premise (lines 20-60): guide is driven by a Brief receipt; built guide reads Receipt+PrepSession and has no brief link, so the whole data-flow diagram is wrong.
Regeneration/idempotence (lines 61, 697-704): create on a unique receiptId means second generation errors; the stageLog-preserving overwrite is unbuilt, and model output is never validated.
Public-context entity inference (lines 725-729, 866): model has no retrieval, yet spec lists LinkedIn/Crunchbase as sources; invites fabricated facts about named people.

summary.note: Spec has no real citations; implemented/partly/not: IMPLEMENTED = route /guide/[receiptId] + page, GET/POST/PATCH API, ModeSelector, ExplorerSpine, DecideHeader, artifact modal (title+abstract), post-call log, density toggle (5 levels, localStorage), owner gate, rate limit, outcome_target (not in spec). PARTLY = StageData (flat strings), stage count (mode-driven 1/2/3-5), testingAboutThem required by prompt only, bet/prep hours stored not editable, stageLog (one entry per stage), public-context labeling ([inferred] only). NOT BUILT = BriefReceipt-driven guide, brief CTA/link, CompassSeed/EntityInput, panelMembers, userEdits, activeStageId persistence, regeneration+modal, brief write-back, print/PDF, error states, output validation.
